prompt: A boss has almost no mechanics: the raid just has to deal enough damage before it enrages after 6 minutes.
why: A damage race against a timer is a gear check.
trap: There's nothing to watch for or move around.

prompt: The boss hits the tank so hard that only a raid with strong enough healers can keep them alive.
tells: only a raid with strong enough healers
why: Testing raw healing output is a gear check.
trap: Nothing needs coordinating; it's all about output.

prompt: Many guilds can't kill the first boss of a new raid until they've upgraded their equipment.
why: When gear decides success, it's a gear check.
trap: Better play won't fix it; better items will.

prompt: The boss grows stronger every 30 seconds, so the fight is really a race on the raid's damage numbers.
tells: a race on the raid's damage numbers
why: A scaling timer makes it a gear check.
trap: Damage race, not dodging, decides it.

prompt: Players with lower item levels report the encounter is impossible no matter how well they move.
tells: no matter how well they move
why: If movement doesn't matter, it's testing gear.
trap: It's not a positioning test if movement doesn't help.

prompt: A designer builds a fight that is mostly 'hit the boss hard and keep the tanks alive'.
tells: hit the boss hard and keep the tanks alive
why: Mostly output and survival is a gear check.
trap: No cues, positions or roles are being tested.
